meta.scene: The needle drops. A clothes peg in each hand.
The first sheet goes up and fills like a sail.
Across the street, the saxophone finds the tune.
Pigeons on the water tank, judging the pegs.
The wind takes a pillowcase. Nobody chases it.
The beat drops out. Just strings, and the sheets breathing.
Everything is dry. Nobody takes it down yet.
The sax player closes the window. Sunset.
